identificationModule.briefTitle: Iressa for EGFR Mutation Negative Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Trial of Gefitinib Monotherapy in Pretreated Patients With Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer Not Harboring Active EGFR Mutations

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The investigators will examine efficacy and toxicity of gefitinib in Korean patients with EGFR wild tumors diagnosed with direct sequence test.

armGroups.label: Iressa for EGFR wild group
armGroups.description: salvage Iressa therapy for patients with EGFR mutation negative NSCLC patients

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The number of patients who live longer than 6 months after enrollment
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months after the enrollment of the last patients

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pathologically proven NSCLC
* Ineligibile for curative treatment (namely, stage IIIb or IV)
* History of one to three prior systemic chemotherapy tumors without active EGFR mutations (exon 19 deletion, L858R mutation in exon 21)
* At least one lesion that was unidimensionally measurable by computed tomography (by RECIST 1.1)
* 18 years old or older
* Performance status ECOG 0-2
* Adequate organ function as evidenced by the following:

  * Absolute neutrophil count \> 1.0 x 109/L
  * Platelets \> 75 x 109/L
  * Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 UNL
  * AST and/or ALT \< 5 UNL
  * Creatinine clearance ≥ 45mL/min

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous EGFR TKI therapy history
* Systemic anticancer therapy within the previous 3 weeks
* Other invasive malignancy within the past 2 years except non-melanoma skin cancer, in situ cervix cancer, or papillary thyroid cancer
* Other concurrent illness that would preclude study participation (severe heart disease)
* Other concurrent physical condition (e.g., infectious disease) that would preclude study participation
* Pregnant or nursing
